en.headline: HKEX proposes easier spin-offs and higher thresholds for major deals
en.dek: The exchange seeks feedback on raising the major-transaction bar from 25 to 50 per cent and shortening the spin-off waiting period from three years to one.
body: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong published a consultation paper on Monday setting out proposals to give listed companies greater flexibility in corporate transactions while keeping investor safeguards through enhanced disclosure and board accountability.

Under the plans, the threshold for classifying a deal as a major transaction would rise from 25 per cent to 50 per cent of a company’s assets, revenue or other size tests. Transactions falling between the old and new thresholds would require only announcement rather than shareholder approval. The exchange also proposes removing the very substantial disposal and very substantial acquisition categories.

For spin-offs, the waiting period after a parent’s listing would be cut from three years to one year. Eligible issuers with market capitalisation of at least HK$10 billion and revenue of at least HK$1 billion would be able to self-assess compliance with Practice Note 15 without prior exchange approval, provided the remaining business accounts for more than half of the group’s revenue and assets. The current requirement to offer existing shareholders an assured entitlement to the spun-off company would be dropped.

The consultation forms the second phase of the exchange’s listing-framework competitiveness review and runs for 10 weeks until 30 November 2026. The exchange said the changes aim to align Hong Kong more closely with practices in markets such as the United Kingdom and Singapore.

zh.headline: 港交所建議放寬分拆及提高主要交易門檻
zh.dek: 聯交所就第二階段上市機制競爭力檢討徵詢意見，建議主要交易門檻由25%提高至50%，分拆暫止期由三年縮短至一年。
body: 香港聯合交易所有限公司周一刊發諮詢文件，提出優化上市發行人進行公司交易的監管規定，讓企業在保持投資者保障的同時，有更大靈活性進行交易。
建議將主要交易的規模測試門檻由現行25%提高至50%，介乎兩者之間的交易只需刊發公告，毋須股東批准。聯交所亦建議取消非常重大出售事項及非常重大收購事項的分類。
分拆上市方面，母公司上市後不得提出分拆申請的暫止期將由三年縮短至一年。市值不少於100億港元及收益不少於10億港元的合資格發行人，可自行評估是否符合《第15項應用指引》，毋須事先取得聯交所批准，前提是餘下業務的收益及總資產佔集團逾五成。現行須向現有股東提供保證權利的規定亦建議刪除。
諮詢為上市機制競爭力檢討的第二階段，為期10周，至2026年11月30日結束。聯交所指，有關建議旨在提升香港上市機制的競爭力，並與英國及新加坡等市場的做法更為接近。
